info.name: HIKARU AI Theme v1 — Stylish Publication.
info.description:
A dark, HIKARU-inspired user style for the Stylish browser extension. Deep black
surfaces (`#000000`), a green accent (`#53b559`), indigo ink (`#6c83df`), and
crisp diff colors (`#40c977` added / `#fa423e` removed) with a skill-highlight
purple (`#ad7bf9`). Designed for ChatGPT/Codex web surfaces and general dark.
info.additionalInfo:
Inspired by HIKARU AI v3.6 PROTOS-1.
Created by sashasmith-syber.
